title: Blue baby operation (Blalock-Thomas-Taussig shunt)
summary: Lab supervisor Vivien Thomas developed and taught the surgical technique for the first blue baby operation, first performed in November 1944.
why: Opened the era of heart surgery on children.

notes.problem: 'Unacknowledged until 1976' is too strong: source records a 1969 portrait and a 1971 ceremony honouring him first.

unsung.contribution: Developed the surgical technique for the shunt that treated blue baby syndrome, and taught it to surgeons.
unsung.recognition: The 1945 paper credited Blalock and Taussig and did not mention him; Johns Hopkins gave him an honorary doctorate in 1976.
